race.description: 2026 Ladbrokes Sunshine Stars Yearling Sale Classic Heat 2 - 2yo Fillies
race.comment: FIT AND READY (5) has been racing very well and deserved her win last start, scoring by 2 metres over 1660m at this track. Steps up a level but she is capable of running another big race. JEWEL REASON (1) settled close to the pace then eventually took over and kept finding to take out a 1660m race at this track last start, scoring by 8 metres and recording her maiden success in the process. Has the benefit of a good draw. This looks a sterner test than last time but she is capable of making it consecutive wins. SHAKE (6) is taking on a far easier race this time after finishing eighth in a Group One at her latest appearance over 1660m at this track, beaten 8 metres by Mullum Showgirl. A big run while fresh is on the cards. TWIN CITIES (7) is in the mix if she can recapture the form from two starts back that saw her score over 1780m at Redcliffe.
